audit_type: exploratory retrospective independent scientific validity audit plus new scripted diagnostic controls
registration_status: analysis plan recorded before audit extraction; investigator has seen user-supplied preliminary counts and historical documentation
population: All terminal internal episodes in RELEASE_INDEX runs, retaining invalid executions; main timing cohort is valid P0 non-clean with pending_allowed=false from exact frozen contracts
joins: cohort + episode_id; request id scoped to original batch trace directory; tool_call_id + within-call action ordinal; gateway_index; HTTP operation_id; backend event ids; receipt id
clock_rule: Use monotonic intervals within original episode host; cross-check wall-minus-monotonic offsets. Public observation creation interval is anchor + [age_ms, age_ms+1)/1000. Admission audit is a transaction-internal marker, not exact authorization read or commit. No submillisecond certainty claim.

opportunities.A: public observation creation upper bound precedes admission audit minus margin, pending visibly present and public authority prohibited or verify-required and protection technically available
opportunities.B: A plus actionable parsed native response ends before admission audit minus margin
opportunities.C: A plus ordinary business commit-return upper bound precedes admission audit minus margin; business operation is deferrable relative to unconditional service suspend/cancel

positive_controls.validity: historical oracle technical validity plus complete raw logs and no worker errors; hypothesis agreement scored separately

uncertainty: Source-task cluster bootstrap, seeded, where reported. Repeated seeds, policies and model siblings remain in same task cluster.
clustering: Optional exploratory normalized Levenshtein action-category distance; report stability before interpreting clusters; omit if uninformative
constraints: no original evidence or source modification
